_about: Original coven-flavored verses inscribed onto the page during play and during replay scoring milestones. Written for Coven Pool — not transcribed from any film or text.
quotes: We are the daughters their pyres did not finish.
By the third moon, the iron remembers.
Speak the name backwards and the door opens.
We do not ask. We summon.
The smoke writes what the tongue forgets.
What burns in the heart-iron is owed.
Three knots, three winds, three turns.
She is the wound and the binding both.
The hour belongs to whoever lights the candle.
Salt under the threshold, salt under the tongue.
